description: Restores every in-scope session's baseline to the revision the test originally ran against, and clears any pending (unsaved) accept/reject/region resolution back to unresolved. Unlike every other eyes_resolve_*/eyes_inspect_* tool, the URL's shape is not just a locator — it IS the scope: a session URL (even with a /steps/N suffix) resets only that one session, while a bare batch URL resets every session in the batch. If the user asks to reset "the batch"/"everything"/"all sessions" but only a session or step URL is on hand (e.g. reused from an earlier call in this conversation), strip it down to the bare batch form first — passing the session URL as-is will silently under-scope the reset. Destructive and not undoable — only call it with explicit user approval of that exact scope.

url.description: Either a session URL or a batch URL — whichever shape you pass IS the scope, and the two are not interchangeable; choose deliberately based on the scope the user approved. Eyes session URL: https://eyes.applitools.com/app/test-results/{batchId}/{sessionId}[/steps/{N}]?accountId=... (the /steps/N suffix is ignored if present). Resets ONLY that session. Eyes batch URL: https://eyes.applitools.com/app/test-results/{batchId}/?accountId=... with no trailing /{sessionId} segment — unlike elsewhere in this API, adding one is not a harmless no-op here; it would switch the scope down to just that one session (use the session-URL form above for that case instead). Resets every session in the batch.

workspaceRoot.description: Root directory of the caller's project (optional; used to locate its .env credentials)

name: eyes_resolve_reset
